subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should `PluginHookAgentContext.api.resetSession` be a supported API only for `after_compaction`, or a broader capability on embedded-agent hook contexts?
rationale: This creates a new plugin contract with session-state authority; code review can verify lifecycle mechanics, but maintainers must choose the permanent hook scope before external plugins rely on it.

options.title: Scope to after-compaction
options.body: Expose the API only to after-compaction contexts and require one lifecycle-owned queue across all compaction implementations.

options.title: Support broader hook access
options.body: Approve reset requests from broader embedded hook contexts and document and test the lifecycle semantics for each supported hook phase.

options.title: Pause the API addition
options.body: Keep reset orchestration internal until a separately reviewed plugin session-control contract is designed.

recommendation.title: Scope to after-compaction
recommendation.body: Expose the API only to after-compaction contexts and require one lifecycle-owned queue across all compaction implementations.

likelyOwner.reason: The contributor guide identifies @jalehman as the compaction and context-engine owner, which is the central boundary requiring a product decision.
